candidates.text: Her speech does not become conduct just because the State may call it that
candidates.speaker: Gorsuch
phrases: The First Amendment is no word game
candidates.reason: States the case's rule: relabeling talk therapy as conduct or treatment cannot evade the First Amendment.

candidates.text: Medical consensus, too, is not static; it evolves and always has
candidates.speaker: Gorsuch

candidates.text: The Constitution does not pose a barrier to reasonable regulation of harmful medical treatments
candidates.speaker: Jackson

candidates.text: But the First Amendment stands as a shield against any effort to enforce orthodoxy
candidates.speaker: Gorsuch
